description: This is a test class file for the MembershipDao component within the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests for various methods of the MembershipDao, including add, edit, retrieve, delete memberships, and checking for existing membership names.

classes.name: MembershipDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the MembershipDao functions related to managing Membership entities in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, creating a new MembershipDao instance and populating test data from fixtures.

methods.name: testAddMembership
methods.description: Tests the addition of a new Membership record and verifies it was saved correctly.

methods.name: testEditMembership
methods.description: Tests updating an existing Membership's name and verifies the change persisted.

methods.name: testGetMembershipList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the list of Membership records with filtering parameters.

methods.name: testGetMembershipById
methods.description: Tests fetching a Membership by its ID and verifies the record details.

methods.name: testDeleteMemberships
methods.description: Tests deleting multiple Membership records and confirms correct deletion count.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Tests deleting a non-existing Membership record and expects zero deletions.

methods.name: testIsExistingMembershipName
methods.description: Tests marking the existence of various membership names, case-insensitive and with whitespace.
